header: Discover and deploy agents in the Microsoft Defender portal
content:
Defender portal
Select Copy link to copy the agent's details page URL and share it with a security
administrator, if you don't have permissions to deploy agents.
For partner-published agents, complete the purchase and deploy on the Security
Store website
, as described in the Microsoft Security Store documentation.
You can manage centralized purchases for partner-published agents through public
offers, or through private offers, as described in How to Purchase SaaS Solutions
(Private Offers).
5. After purchasing the agent, select Security Copilot > Agents, find your agent in the
Ready for setup section, and then select Set up to begin agent setup.
For more information on setting up, managing, and running partner-published agents,
see Manage Security Copilot agents.
For more information on Microsoft Security Copilot agents, see Microsoft Security Copilot
agents in Microsoft Defender.
After setup, the agent appears in the Agents in use section.
This section details the Microsoft Security Copilot agents that are available in the Microsoft
Defender portal.
